gloss: branches and leaves; minor details; nonessentials

definitions.explanation: The branches and foliage of a tree or plant.
Figuratively, the trivial or secondary aspects of something, as opposed to the main point or trunk (the core issue).

examples.japanese: {枝葉|えだは}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{茂|しげ}っている→茂る：03924_shigeru⟧。
examples.english: The branches and leaves are thick.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{枝葉|えだは}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{散|ち}らばった→散らばる：12713_chirabaru⟧。
examples.english: Branches and leaves were scattered by the typhoon.
I pruned the branches and leaves of the garden tree.

examples.japanese: {枝葉|えだは}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦こだわら→こだわる：10319_kodawaru⟧ず⟦{本質|ほんしつ}→本質：04810_honshitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}よう→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: Let's not get caught up in minor details and look at the essence.

examples.japanese: {枝葉|えだは}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}られた→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: We spent time on side issues.

examples.japanese: {枝葉|えだは}{末節|まっせつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧とらわれず、⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{方向性|ほうこうせい}→方向性：28189_houkousei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めましょう→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: Let's not get bogged down in trivial details and decide on the overall direction.

notes:
The literal meaning (branches and leaves) naturally extends to the figurative meaning of 'nonessential details,' in contrast to the trunk (⟦{幹|みき}→幹：04364_miki⟧) which represents the core or main point.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {枝葉|えだは}{末節|まっせつ}: trivial details; nonessentials — a four-character compound emphasizing the unimportant
- {枝葉|えだは}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦こだわる→こだわる：10319_kodawaru⟧: to get caught up in minor details
- {枝葉|えだは}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧: side-issue debate
- {枝葉|えだは}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to prune; to trim away the nonessentials

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {末節|まっせつ}: trivial detail — similar to the figurative sense of {枝葉|えだは}, often used together
- ⟦{些細|ささい}→些細：07160_sasai⟧な: trivial; minor — an adjective describing something of little importance
- ⟦{本質|ほんしつ}→本質：04810_honshitsu⟧: essence — the opposite: the core matter rather than the peripheral details
